name: @jev-playground/pi
description: This repository as a Pi agent. A workspace root holding two ALTERNATIVE profiles -- components/ (five separate extensions) and resident/ (jev-hermes alone) -- and the probe that measures which seam each one takes. Deliberately not a Pi package itself: it declares no `pi` key and has no extensions/ directory, so pointing pi at this directory loads nothing and cannot load both profiles at once. test.ts holds that in place.
